address: Rua Oscar Freire 384, São Paulo, 01426-000, Brazil
bio: A new chapter begins at the luxurious Hotel Emiliano (One MICHELIN Key) with the arrival of chef Vinícius Pires, whose career has taken him across Europe and to three-MICHELIN-starred Evvai. In an elegant and sophisticated, fully renovated setting shared with the open kitchen, the chef presents an offering rooted in Brazilian cuisine, interpreted in a contemporary, produce-led style through dishes brimming with modern techniques and refined flavours. The selection, updated weekly, brings together traditional ingredients from northern Brazil, such as peach palm and tucupi, and international ingredients including shiso and Cantabrian anchovies. Experienced sommelier Luís Otávio Álvares Cruz presents an appealing selection of wines to complete the experience!
